Check a data set against its specification with extra checks

Source: R/checks.R
ysx_check.Rd

Runs yspec::ys_check() and then three additional checks:

Usage

ysx_check(
  data,
  spec,
  verbose = FALSE,
  output = tempfile(),
  error_on_fail = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

a data frame

spec

a yspec object

verbose

logical; if TRUE, extra messages are printed during the check

output

the name of a file or a connection for writing check results

error_on_fail

if FALSE, return logical check status rather than generating an error

Value

Invisibly, TRUE if all checks pass; otherwise an error is raised, or FALSE is returned when error_on_fail = FALSE.

Details

  1. Missing values, using ysx_check_missing(). By default, columns may not contain missing values; set na_ok: true in a column's dots to allow them.

  2. Repeats within groups, using ysx_check_repeats(). By default, each combination of group: true columns must occur once. Set pre_grp_count: <n> in the dots of the group columns to require n rows, or pre_grp_count: ~ (YAML null) to skip this check. All group columns that set it must agree. error_on_fail is forwarded.

  3. Time-varying columns. The data are grouped by all columns with group: true (default false). A column with time_varying: false (default) must be constant within each group; a column with time_varying: true must vary within at least one group.

Before any check, data and spec must match: every column in data must be a variable in spec, and every variable in spec must be a column in data. With error_on_fail = TRUE a mismatch raises an error; with FALSE it is reported with the other problems. ysx_check_missing() on its own only requires the data columns to be in the spec.
